spanish: Y darán hijos de Aarón el sacerdote fuego sobre el altar, y ordenarán leños sobre el fuego.

findings.issue: Bare postverbal hijos is the object of darán, so an unnamed they give the sons of Aaron the priest; the 3cp subject of נתן is those sons, and the object is fire.

notes: Second clause matches the 3cp arrange-woods-on-the-fire tokens if its subject is the sons.
